deepresearch.title: What is DeepResearch?
deepresearch.body: An autonomous agent that crawls the web, reads dozens of sources in parallel, and produces a structured report with inline citations — all in under 3 minutes.

deepresearch.title: How it works
deepresearch.body: Give it a topic. It breaks the question into sub-queries, searches the web, scores source credibility, extracts key claims, and synthesizes a coherent narrative.

deepresearch.title: Try it: market analysis
deepresearch.body: Ask: 'What are the top 5 risks in the EU AI Act for SaaS startups?' — get a 1,200-word report with sources linked and a risk table, ready to share.

codeweaver.title: What is CodeWeaver?
codeweaver.body: A full-stack coding agent that reads your entire repo, plans multi-file changes, writes tests, and opens a pull request — without you touching a single file.

codeweaver.title: How it works
codeweaver.body: Connect your GitHub repo. Describe the feature or bug. CodeWeaver maps the codebase, writes a plan, implements it across files, runs tests, and opens a PR.

codeweaver.title: Try it: add dark mode
codeweaver.body: Say: 'Add a dark mode toggle to my React app.' It finds your theme setup, adds CSS variables, creates a toggle component, and wires it to localStorage.

data-scout.title: What is Data Scout?
data-scout.body: Drop a CSV or connect a database. Data Scout profiles your data, spots anomalies, runs statistical tests, and generates interactive charts — no SQL required.

data-scout.title: How it works
data-scout.body: Upload your dataset. The agent infers schema, computes distributions, detects outliers, runs correlation analysis, and returns a visual report in minutes.

data-scout.title: Try it: sales data
data-scout.body: Upload a CSV of monthly sales. Ask: 'What is driving the Q3 dip?' — get a chart, a breakdown by region, and a plain-English explanation.

infra-sentinel.title: What is Infra Sentinel?
infra-sentinel.body: A 24/7 infrastructure monitoring agent. It watches your Kubernetes cluster, detects anomalies, and auto-remediates common issues before they become incidents.

infra-sentinel.title: How it works
infra-sentinel.body: Connect your cloud provider. Sentinel polls metrics every 30 seconds, compares against baselines, and either resolves the issue or pages your on-call engineer.

infra-sentinel.title: Try it: OOM detection
infra-sentinel.body: When a pod exceeds memory limits, Sentinel captures a heap dump, logs the trace, scales the deployment, and sends a Slack alert — all without human intervention.

market-pulse.title: What is Market Pulse?
market-pulse.body: A real-time financial intelligence agent. It monitors stocks, news, and social sentiment to surface investment signals and risks before the market moves.

market-pulse.title: How it works
market-pulse.body: Set a watchlist. Market Pulse aggregates earnings, filings, analyst reports, Reddit, and X sentiment — then scores each ticker with a bullish/bearish confidence.

market-pulse.title: Try it: earnings season
market-pulse.body: Watch NVDA before earnings. Get: pre-call sentiment score, key analyst price targets, top 3 Reddit threads, and a risk/reward summary in one view.

customer-agent.title: What is Customer Agent?
customer-agent.body: An always-on support agent that resolves 80% of tickets autonomously — pulling from your docs, knowledge base, and past tickets — and escalates the rest.

customer-agent.title: How it works
customer-agent.body: Connect your Zendesk or Intercom. The agent reads your docs and past resolutions, then handles new tickets, drafts responses, and closes resolved cases.

customer-agent.title: Try it: refund request
customer-agent.body: Customer says: 'I was charged twice.' The agent looks up their order, confirms the duplicate charge, issues the refund, and sends a confirmation email automatically.

legal-reviewer.title: What is Legal Reviewer?
legal-reviewer.body: An AI contract analysis agent. It reads legal documents, highlights risk clauses, compares against your standard templates, and flags anything unusual.

legal-reviewer.title: How it works
legal-reviewer.body: Upload a PDF. Legal Reviewer parses clause types, maps risk level, compares against your playbook, and produces a structured redline with severity scores.

legal-reviewer.title: Try it: vendor NDA
legal-reviewer.body: Upload a vendor NDA. Get: a list of non-standard clauses, IP ownership red flags, termination risks, and a one-paragraph exec summary to share with your legal team.

doc-translator.title: What is Doc Translator?
doc-translator.body: A document translation agent with domain awareness. It translates technical, legal, and medical documents across 40+ languages while preserving formatting and tone.

doc-translator.title: How it works
doc-translator.body: Upload a document (PDF, DOCX, or HTML). The agent detects the domain, applies specialized terminology, and returns a translated version with the original layout intact.

doc-translator.title: Try it: medical report
doc-translator.body: Upload a Spanish radiology report. Get back an English version with correct anatomical terms, units preserved, and a glossary of translated clinical terms.

design-critic.title: What is Design Critic?
design-critic.body: An AI design review agent. Upload a screenshot or Figma link — it scores your UI on accessibility, visual hierarchy, contrast, and UX patterns, with specific fixes.

design-critic.title: How it works
design-critic.body: Share a design. The agent analyses contrast ratios, spacing consistency, font hierarchy, touch target sizes, and common anti-patterns — then lists prioritised fixes.

design-critic.title: Try it: landing page
design-critic.body: Upload your landing page screenshot. Get: 3 critical contrast failures, 2 hierarchy issues, a WCAG score, and specific CSS fixes for each problem.

sql-writer.title: What is SQL Writer?
sql-writer.body: A natural language to SQL agent. Describe what data you need in plain English, point it at your schema, and get production-ready SQL queries instantly.

sql-writer.title: How it works
sql-writer.body: Connect your database schema. Type a question like 'Show me top 10 customers by revenue this quarter.' The agent returns an optimised, commented SQL query.

sql-writer.title: Try it: cohort analysis
sql-writer.body: Ask: 'What is the 30-day retention rate for users who signed up in January?' Get a multi-join cohort query with window functions, ready to paste into your BI tool.

meeting-scribe.title: What is Meeting Scribe?
meeting-scribe.body: A meeting intelligence agent. Join a call and it transcribes in real-time, identifies speakers, extracts action items, and sends structured notes to your team.

meeting-scribe.title: How it works
meeting-scribe.body: Invite the bot to your Zoom, Meet, or Teams call. It transcribes, diarises speakers, groups topics, and delivers a structured summary with owners and due dates.

meeting-scribe.title: Try it: product standup
meeting-scribe.body: Run your daily standup with Scribe. After 10 minutes get: per-person updates, blockers, 3 action items with owners, and a one-para summary ready to post in Slack.
